name: Perth NRM Swan Alcoa Landcare Program (SALP)

funder.name: Alcoa of Australia and the Department of Biodiversity, Conservation and Attractions (DBCA)

summary: Community Landcare grants in the Swan region of Western Australia for on-ground work to retain or restore bushland, rivers, wetlands and coastal foreshore and to improve ecological linkages.

eligibility.rule: Have an ABN or a Sponsor with an ABN to hold funds
Have a group or organisation bank account, or a Sponsor with one
Locate the project within the Perth NRM Region
Have written approval from the landowner or manager
Do not begin activities before entering into the Funding Agreement
Deliver a public environmental benefit, not a private benefit only

documents: Evidence of Aboriginal Heritage Consultation, if applicable
Confirmation of Partners Co-Investors, unless included in Attachment 3
Confirmation of Land Manager Future Commitment, unless included in Attachment 3

status.quote: Applications are to be submitted electronically through the online application form by 6pm Thursday 30th April 2026.

deadline.quote: Applications are to be submitted electronically through the online application form by 6pm Thursday 30th April 2026.

administered_by.quote: The Swan Alcoa Landcare Program (SALP) is a Community Landcare Grants Program Funded by Alcoa of Australia and the Department of Biodiversity, Conservation and Attractions (DBCA).

applicant_types.quote: by funding the community to enhance and restore critical habitat and ecological linkages within the Swan Region

geography.quote: by funding the community to enhance and restore critical habitat and ecological linkages within the Swan Region

access.quote: Applications are to be submitted electronically through the online application form

window.quote: Applications are to be submitted electronically through the online application form by 6pm Thursday 30th April 2026.

effort.quote: Applications must be received by 6pm Thursday 30th April 2026.

eligibility.quote: Applicants need to have an Australian Business Number (ABN). Groups without an ABN will need a Sponsor to hold funds on their behalf.

Applicants need a bank account held in the community group or organisation name. Grant funds cannot be administered from personal bank accounts. Groups without a valid bank account need a Sponsor with a valid bank account to hold funds on their behalf.
Be located within the Perth NRM Region (see Appendix 1)
Have written approval from the landowner/manager to undertake proposed works
Retrospective activities or activities that have already commenced before entering into a Funding Agreement with Perth NRM.
Activities which deliver a private benefit only, such as gardening or landscaping.

after_award.quote: A project report at the end of the project period, due 31 March 2028, is a requirement of this grant.

documents.quote: Attachment 1 - Site Description (using template) Attachment 2 - Maps Attachment 3 - Confirmation of Land Manager Consent Attachment 4 - Evidence of Aboriginal Heritage Consultation (if applicable) Attachment 5 - Declaration of Interest (if applicable) Attachment 6 - Budget (using template) Attachment 7 - Quotes
Attachment 8 - Confirmation of Partners Co-Investors (unless included in Attachment 3)
Attachment 9 - Confirmation of Land Manager Future Commitment (unless included in Attachment 3)
